title: GitHub
description: A token lets Opsifier read private repositories and add the webhook behind auto-deploy. It is checked with GitHub before being stored.
tokenHint: The repo scope is enough to deploy. Auto-deploy also needs admin:repo_hook, or Webhooks read and write on a fine-grained token.

errors.clientIdRequired: Paste the client ID of the OAuth app.
errors.clientSecretRequired: Paste the client secret of the OAuth app.

connectedOauth: Connected as {{login}}, through the OAuth app

oauth.title: OAuth app
oauth.description: Instead of a token, register an OAuth app on GitHub and let Opsifier ask for its own access. Register one with the callback below, then save its client ID and secret here.
oauth.callbackHint: GitHub only sends people back to the address the app was registered with, so this panel has to be reachable there.

errors.invalid_state: That sign-in has expired or was already used. Try again.
errors.not_configured: The OAuth app was removed in the meantime.
errors.exchange_failed: GitHub did not issue a token. Check the app's client secret and callback URL.

oauth.clientSecretHint: Stays on this server once saved, and isn't shown again.
